abstract:
Official code of the paper titled "RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures"

# RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures **Authors:** [Hanan Gani](https://hananshafi.github.io/), [Tejal Kulkarni](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=j1Sh_joAAAAJ&hl=en), [Madhoolika Chodavarapu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/madhoolikac), [Nicklas Hansen](https://www.nicklashansen.com/), [Manmohan Chandraker](https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~mkchandraker/) **Affiliation:** University of California, San Diego ### ECCV 2026 ### [**Project Page**](https://hananshafi.github.io/RoboTALES/) **|** [**Paper**](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.06018) **|** [**arXiv**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.06018) ## 🗂️ Repository Structure ## 🛠️ Installation Create the environment: Install the simulation environment (cloned into `packages/`): Install the Python packages: Tested with **Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.1.0, CUDA 11.8**, and `xformers` for memory-efficient attention. ## 🧾 Checkpoints and Datasets ### Trained RoboTALES checkpoints (Hugging Face) The trained checkpoints are hosted at **[hanangani/robotales-ckpts](https://huggingface.co/hanangani/robotales-ckpts)**: | Benchmark | File | |---|---| | RoboCasa | `robocasa_ckpt/robotales-trained-robocasa.ckpt` (~14 GB) | | LIBERO-10 | `libero10_ckpt/robotales-trained-libero10.ckpt` (~12 GB) | Download into `video_model/checkpoints/` (run from `video_model/`): Then point a config at the checkpoint you want (training or eval), e.g.: ### Other required assets (not in this repo) - **OpenCLIP ViT-H-14 weights** — the conditioner loads `checkpoints/open_clip_pytorch_model.bin` (`laion2b_s32b_b79k`). Grab it from [laion/CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K](https://huggingface.co/laion/CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K) and place it under `checkpoints/`. - **RoboCasa demo datasets** — needed for closed-loop RoboCasa eval (reset states). Download the simulation dataset and place the extracted `datasets/` folder under `video_model/`: Expected layout (under `video_model/`): ## 🧠 LLM Planner The hierarchical planner
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 RoboTALES 的官方代码，该论文题为“RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures”。作者包括 Hanan Gani、Tejal Kulkarni、Madhoolika Chodavarapu、Nicklas Hansen 和 Manmohan Chandraker，均来自加州大学圣迭戈分校。该工作被 ECCV 2026 接收。仓库提供了完整的代码、安装指南、预训练检查点（支持 RoboCasa 和 LIBERO-10 基准）以及数据集准备说明。RoboTALES 采用层次化规划器，结合 LLM 进行推理，并通过任务对齐的模拟未来来引导机器人策略学习。
tldr_zh: RoboTALES 通过任务对齐的模拟未来，实现推理引导的机器人策略学习。
cover_zh: 机器人也能“想”了？RoboTALES 用模拟未来让策略更聪明！

judge.reason: 官方代码，提出推理引导的机器人策略，结合视频预测与LLM规划，在RoboCasa和LIBERO上验证，有完整训练和评估流程。
